summary: Roll7 and 505 Games' minimalist competitive arena-sports game, built around teams activating moving laser walls and surviving the resulting patterns.

entries.title: Laser League

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows; online multiplayer depends on service/player availability.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Laser League released in early access on Windows before its full 2018 release for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the multiplayer arena-sports game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4 or Xbox One only for console access.

all_releases.fidelity: PC full release with configurable fidelity.
